issue_zh: 阶段推进后颜色不随活动阶段变化。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: Stage track colors did not change when the active phase advanced in the San browser page.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The San s-for declaration did not bind a loop index, while its class expression referenced index.
fix_evidence: fix: {"after": "s-for=\"phase, index in phases trackby phase.key\"", "before": "s-for=\"phase in phases trackby phase.key\"", "scope": "Only the loop declaration was changed; Vue source and formal_30_v1 artifacts were not modified."}

issue_zh: 人工浏览器检查未发现 Vue/San 差异。

primary_category_zh: 初始化或生命周期迁移
issue_zh: 缺少初始裁剪框；参数不能驱动画布；宽高比锁定样式与功能异常。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The San component rendered without the initial crop box and initial input values. | follow_up_issue: Changing a numeric parameter did not move or resize the crop box on the canvas. | lock_issue: The lock-aspect-ratio row did not match the Vue layout, and enabling the checkbox did not apply the aspect-ratio update.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: San initialized crop as an empty object but had no inited hook to copy initialCrop into crop, unlike the Vue created hook. | follow_up_root_cause: The input handler passed `event` instead of San's `$event` expression, so update() did not receive the DOM event and crop remained unchanged. | lock_root_cause: The checkbox inherited the numeric-field grid layout, and the migrated Vue-style watch object was not registered by the San component runtime.
fix_evidence: fix: {"added": "inited() { const initialCrop = this.data.get('initialCrop'); this.data.set('crop', Object.assign({}, initialCrop)); }", "scope": "Only the v2 San artifact was changed; Vue source and formal_30_v1 artifacts were not modified."} | follow_up_fix: {"after": "on-input=\"update(field, $event)\"", "before": "on-input=\"update(field, event)\""} | lock_fix: {"behavior": "Registered this.watch('locked', ...) in inited() and removed the inactive Vue-style watch object.", "style": "Added a dedicated lock-control flex row and placed the checkbox before the label text visually."}

issue_zh: 人工浏览器检查未发现 Vue/San 差异。
单行选择和全选后，选择样式不更新。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: Clicking a single batch checkbox did not change the row selection style, and the select-visible button did not produce a visible selection effect.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The San template called isSelected(batch.id) and batchRowClass(batch) without passing selectedIds. Because these ordinary method calls did not expose selectedIds as template dependencies, San did not recompute the checkbox and row class after selectedIds changed.
fix_evidence: fix: {"method_change": "isSelected and batchRowClass now consume the selectedIds argument supplied by the template.", "scope": "Only the v2 San artifact was changed; formal_30_v1 and Vue source remain unchanged.", "template_after": "batchRowClass(batch, selectedIds), isSelected(batch.id, selectedIds)", "template_before": "batchRowClass(batch), isSelected(batch.id)"}

issue_zh: 决策和批注操作不生效，提交批注会触发页面刷新。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The changes and approved decisions could not be selected, resolve/reopen/delete note actions had no visible effect, and submitting a new note refreshed the page.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: Two independent migration defects were present. First, the handlers mutated nested objects returned by the selectedAsset computed value directly. Those plain-object mutations bypassed San data updates, so selectedAsset, visibleNotes, decisionText, classes, and the note list were not recomputed. Second, Vue's @submit.prevent modifier was translated to on-submit without preserving preventDefault behavior, so the browser performed a native form submission and refreshed the page when a note was added.
fix_evidence: fix: Decision, note resolution, note deletion, and note addition now create new asset/note objects and write the complete next assets array through this.data.set('assets', nextAssets). The note form passes $event to addNote(event), which calls preventDefault() before updating state.

issue_zh: 切换运行时段后文字变化，但按钮颜色不更新。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: After toggling a device time slot, its text and dependent values updated but the button color did not follow the new on/off state.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The San template derived the class through slotClass(device.id, hour), while schedule was read only inside that ordinary method. San therefore did not register schedule as a template-expression dependency and could retain the previous class after schedule changed.
fix_evidence: fix: The template now calls slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule), and slotClass derives the class from the explicitly supplied schedule argument. This makes schedule a reactive dependency without changing the frozen formal_30_v1 artifact.

primary_category_zh: 初始化或生命周期迁移
issue_zh: 缺少初始模拟结果、图表、汇总和月度明细。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The San component opened without the initial simulation result, chart bars, summary values, or monthly detail rows.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The final third-round formal_30_v1 artifact lost the attached() and disposed() lifecycle methods that were present in earlier generated and repair artifacts, so Vue mounted() no longer triggered runSimulation(). It also initialized assumptions with the Vue-style instance access this.initialAssumptions, which is undefined in San initData(). This is a repair regression: the final repair removed previously preserved lifecycle behavior.
fix_evidence: fix: A formal_30_v2 copy restores an inited() hook that reads initialAssumptions through this.data and clones it into assumptions, an attached() hook that runs the initial simulation, and a disposed() hook that clears the pending timer. The frozen formal_30_v1 artifacts remain unchanged.

issue_zh: 标题缺失，节点移动和连线不生效，模拟日志不持续更新。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The San component had no title; node movement and connection creation had no visible effect; simulation did not visibly update node states as expected. After the first reactive-state repair, starting simulation still produced only the 'simulation started' log and no periodic node-status logs.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The Vue title prop default was not initialized in San. In addition, the generated handlers mutated objects and arrays returned by this.data.get() or computed selectedNode directly, including selectedNode coordinates, edges.push(), nodes.push(), and node.status assignment. Those mutations bypassed San's reactive data update path. The simulation timer was also created only during attached() and stored as reactive view data; toggleSimulation() changed only a flag and did not establish that an active timer existed, so the manual runner showed no tick callbacks after simulation was enabled.
fix_evidence: fix: The v2 copy initializes the default title and replaces direct nested mutations with immutable node or edge arrays written through this.data.set(). Rename, move, add-node, connection creation, and simulation tick paths now write complete reactive values. Simulation timer ownership was moved to a component instance field: starting simulation immediately performs one tick and creates the interval, stopping or disposing clears it, and log insertion now writes a new eventLog array. The frozen formal_30_v1 artifact remains unchanged.

issue_zh: 人工浏览器检查未发现 Vue/San 差异。
错误的 s-for/trackby 语法导致 San 模板解析失败。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The San test page failed before rendering with: [SAN ERROR] ROOT>section>div>aside>small>option is closed with button.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: All five migrated loops emitted trackby as a separate unquoted attribute, for example s-for="item in cycles" trackby item. San requires the tracking expression inside the s-for value, for example s-for="item in cycles trackby item". The malformed attributes confused the template parser and produced a misleading tag-closing error. The formal_30_v1 final static validation reported passed despite this syntax, so this is also a validator false negative.
fix_evidence: fix: The v2 copy moves each tracking expression inside its s-for value for cycles, unassigned work, member lanes, lane items, and change-log entries. The repaired template was compiled with the locally installed San package. The frozen formal_30_v1 artifact remains unchanged.

issue_zh: 复选框与百分号相对输入框的位置和 Vue 不一致。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The failing-only checkbox was positioned differently from Vue, and the percent sign for the lab and exam weight inputs appeared before the input instead of after it. All other manual checks passed.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The migration preserved the same elements and text but changed their DOM child order. The checkbox label became text-then-input instead of input-then-text, and each assignment header became label-percent-input instead of label-input-percent. This explains the final dom_structure_similarity_low result despite matching tag and near-matching text metrics.
fix_evidence: fix: The v2 copy restores the Vue child order for the failing-only checkbox and both assignment weight headers. No state or interaction logic was changed, and the repaired template compiles with the local San package.

issue_zh: 内部备注复选框和文字的先后位置与 Vue 不一致。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: The internal-note checkbox appeared after its label text in San, while Vue places the checkbox before the text. The control therefore occupied a different visual position.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The migration reversed the two child nodes inside the reply footer label. Vue renders input-then-text, but the generated San template rendered text-then-input. Shared CSS could not compensate for the changed DOM order.
fix_evidence: fix: Created a formal_30_v2 copy and restored the Vue child order by placing the checkbox input before the internal-note text. No state or interaction logic was changed.

issue_zh: 选择胜出版本后，表格行颜色不实时更新。
observed_issue_evidence: observed_issue: After selecting a winning variant, the corresponding San table row did not change to the winner color immediately, unlike Vue.
root_cause_evidence: root_cause: The San template bound the row class through rowClass(row). The template expression exposed only row as a tracked dependency, while winnerId and leaderId were read inside the component method. Updating winnerId therefore did not invalidate and reevaluate the class binding in real time. Vue rerenders template methods during reactive updates, so the same source pattern works there.
fix_evidence: fix: Created a formal_30_v2 copy and replaced the method-based class binding with an explicit template expression that directly references row.id, winnerId, and leaderId. San can now track both state dependencies and update winner or leader styling immediately; state and event logic were not changed.
